sam-marketing: Quick ask for the webinar deck— can eng/runtime run a fast rerun of the webinar benchmark bundle but with two changes: use the rerank workload (n=5 candidates) and produce per-candidate latency + MRR numbers. Need reproducible commands and the raw CSVs. Target path: s3://redwood-prod/benchmarks/webinar/2026-03/rerank/ . Prefer a 500-sample smoke run (we'll extrapolate). Can you also confirm the hardware used?

eli-eng-runtime: Got it. We can do that. Do you want float-only or float vs 8-bit quantized? Also want cached vs cold?

sam-marketing: Float vs 8-bit please. Cached ON only (we want to show best-case production routing), but include one small cold sample set (50 samples) just for the appendix. Hardware note: call out A40 and A100 if available.

priya-eng-runtime: Picking this up. Plan: deterministic 500 sample pull from the given prefix, run rerank n=5, report per-candidate median+p95 latencies, end-to-end MRR@5, and token counts. Command I'll run (repro snippet):

```
# rerank smoke
tools/bench/run_rerank.sh \
  --s3 s3://redwood-prod/benchmarks/webinar/2026-03/rerank/ \
  --samples 500 \
  --model redwood-rerank-v1 \
  --candidates 5 \
  --quantized both \
  --cache-mode cached \
  --cold-sample 50 \
  --output gs://bench-results/webinar/1952201234/
```

bench-bot: Job queued: id=jb-20260322-8801, est start 12m, queue pos 2.

eli-eng-runtime: One gotcha  the rerank harness expects candidate payloads in the new JSONL schema (fields: query, candidates:[{id,text}]). If older shards still use legacy fields we'll detect and drop rows with a small log. Also will limit context to 4096 tokens to avoid queuing OOM.

priya-eng-runtime: Added schema check + truncation flag. Will emit counts: total_rows, dropped_rows_legacy_schema, truncated_rows. ETA ~1.5h.

[~70m later]

priya-eng-runtime: Run finished. Artifacts uploaded to gs://bench-results/webinar/1952201234/{rerank-500.csv, rerank-50-cold.csv, methods.md}. Short results: overall MRR@5 = 0.67; per-candidate median latencies (ms) = [cand1: 12, cand2: 14, cand3: 15, cand4: 16, cand5: 18]; per-candidate p95 (ms) = [cand1: 45, cand2: 50, cand3: 55, cand4: 60, cand5: 85]. Quantized speedup (median end-to-end) = 1.6x; token-delta measured on heldout-100 = 0.6% token mismatch. Dropped legacy-schema rows = 7 / 500.

dena-comm: This looks good. For the methods blurb can you include exact kernel/runtime tags (eg runtime v2.1.3, cuda 12.1, cudnn 9.x) and the machine type? We need that for the press kit.

eli-eng-runtime: Machines used: 2x A40 for the main run (shared pool), and one A100-80GB for quantized verification. Runtime: redwood-runtime v2.1.3, CUDA 12.1. I added a short machine/environment section to methods.md.

sam-marketing: Perfect. Two tiny asks: (1) can you drop a tiny CSV with top-10 examples where quantization changed ranking (so comms can review), (2) confirm we have permission to publish the MRR numbers as "internal benchmark: rerank workload"?

priya-eng-runtime: Dropped top10-quant-affected.csv to the bucket. Permission: engineering OKs publishing as internal benchmark numbers with the caveat in methods.md (hardware + sample size).

bench-bot: Job completed: id=jb-20260322-8801, duration=00:47:12.

sam-marketing: Awesome. Thanks everyone  will draft slide copy and ping legal if needed. Closing thread once slide is uploaded. :sparkles:
